mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right AEO audit provider for my business?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an AEO audit provider, look for a company with a proven track record in both SEO and AEO, demonstrating a deep understanding of current search engine algorithms and user intent. Evaluate their expertise in schema markup, natural language processing, and content strategy. Request case studies or examples of their work. Ensure they offer a transparent process, clear communication, and customized recommendations tailored to your specific business goals, rather than generic advice. A reputable provider will prioritize actionable insights that directly contribute to your online visibility and lead generation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an AEO audit provider with expertise in SEO, AEO, schema markup, and content strategy. Look for a transparent process, customized recommendations, and a proven track record to ensure actionable insights tailored to your business goals.
